Subject: Launch Update and Next Step

Dear Avery,

Our production launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026. The security review, owned by Nia, now completes on October 12 at the earliest, and release needs completed approval. We therefore cannot confirm a new production date; the review may also require remediation.

We can still run a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data.

I remain confident in the team and in our approach to completing this properly.

Please let me know whether you accept the staging demo on October 8.

Thank you,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
